messages:
mina: Quick sync for the release notes PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4950). Need final wording for the feature bullets + one known-issues line.

ryan: I'll tidy the SDK snippets. Found one JS import still using legacy package name. Will update to @redwood/inference and pin version in comment.

olivia: I'll handle the example outputs. Noticed embeddings example shows 1536 length; that should be a placeholder. Replaced with <embedding_length> and parenthetical note.

mina: Great. Also add a short consumer-friendly line about improved tail latency without technical terms.

ryan: Suggest: "Improved tail latency for inference requests under typical workloads."

mina: Perfect. For known issues: short line: "Intermittent 503s observed for very large batched requests; reduce batch size or use Dedicated pools as a workaround. We're investigating."

docs-checker: Reminder: PR 4950 flagged for missing anchor on dedicated-config.md; add anchor or link will 404 in staging.

olivia: Adding the anchor now in a small PR and will link to the workaround section.

mina: Plan: Ryan merges snippet fix, Olivia merges anchor + example tweak, then I will do a final copy edit and land. Target deploy tomorrow 15:00 PT.
